title: Move to

private.label: Private
private.path: Only you can see these pages

toast.lockedParent: Page is in a locked parent
toast.copyBlockedByOrganization: Your organization doesn’t let pages be duplicated into other workspaces

privateConfirmDetail: No one but you will be able to open this page.

copy.notice: Pages can’t move between workspaces, but you can duplicate them.
copy.title: Page will be duplicated, not moved
copy.stays: The original stays here untouched; a copy is made in the workspace you chose.
copy.mayDiffer: The copy may not carry everything over: links, relations, permissions, page history and other parts can break.

move.notice: You can move or duplicate it to another workspace. Moving ends this workspace’s shares and the relations to databases that stay here.
move.chooseTitle: Duplicate or move the page to {{workspace}}
move.duplicateNote: Duplicate leaves the original here untouched and makes a copy at a new address in the workspace you chose. The copy may not carry everything over: links, relations, permissions, page history and other parts can break.
move.moveNote: Move takes it with its sub-pages and databases, keeping their addresses, along with its comments, page history and favorites, and leaves nothing here. Moving cuts what follows.
move.nothingCut: No relations or shares are cut.
move.cutRelations_one: {{count}} relation to a database that stays here ({{values}} values) is cut and goes to deleted properties.
move.cutRelations_other: {{count}} relations to databases that stay here ({{values}} values) are cut and go to deleted properties.
move.cutPeople_one: {{count}} person who can open this page now won’t be able to.
move.cutPeople_other: {{count}} people who can open this page now won’t be able to.
move.cutPeopleAtLeast_one: {{count}} or more people who can open this page now won’t be able to.
move.cutPeopleAtLeast_other: {{count}} or more people who can open this page now won’t be able to.
move.cutFavorites_one: {{count}} of other people’s favorites is removed.
move.cutFavorites_other: {{count}} of other people’s favorites are removed.
move.across_one: {{count}} mention or link between it and pages that stay here opens only for people who can open both workspaces.
move.across_other: {{count}} mentions and links between it and pages that stay here open only for people who can open both workspaces.
move.cutLinkedViews_one: {{count}} linked database showing a database across the two workspaces loses its data source.
move.cutLinkedViews_other: {{count}} linked databases showing a database across the two workspaces lose their data source.
move.sharedFiles_one: {{count}} file other pages use too stays in this workspace.
move.sharedFiles_other: {{count}} files other pages use too stay in this workspace.
